hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("&&|;|[|][|]")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Chained command blocked. Do not join independent commands with &&, ; or ||. Issue them as separate Bash calls, batching independent ones into a single response so they run in parallel. Pipes are allowed."}} else empty end'
